summary: At the reviewed frozen candidates, helper launch variables and ready schema do not match the real FSBar host CLI or published schema; append-descriptor and route-enable requirements are not supplied; and the invoked normalizer CLI does not exist. The exact alleged CLI returned success with nonexistent inputs while creating no output. Passing isolated tests therefore did not establish a joined executable route. This is retained historical BAR knowledge at the cited capture; recheck applicability before using it on a successor.
title: Stock smoke bootstrap and normalizer interfaces were not executable as joined
